mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT mg.material_group_id AS materialGroupId, mg.group_name AS groupName FROM branch_stock bs JOIN material m ON bs.material_code = m.material_code JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id WHERE bs.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bs.current_qty > 0 ORDER BY mg.group_name

SELECT m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName FROM material m JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id WHERE mg.material_group_id = #{materialGroupId} ORDER BY m.material_name
